name: stepper_oneRevolution
description: The Arduino Stepper library's stepper_oneRevolution, unmodified, on a 28BYJ-48 through its ULN2003 board. The sketch's 200 steps at 60 rpm (5 ms a step, within the motor's pull-in rate) turn the rotor 200 full steps, but this motor has 2037.9 full steps an output turn, so the shaft turns only 34.9 degrees each way, not a revolution, as on the bench. The first word pulls the rotor from its rest at orange to yellow+pink (1.5 steps on), then the library's sequence on this wiring runs against the data sheet's order, so the count goes to -197.5 and back to 2.5.
